notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.26.7:

- The OS / Browser Support Matrix FDC agent is renamed 'DSPM + FDC Agent' and is now structured like the F1E agent: it has its own Windows / macOS / VDI tabs, a new 'Office Versions' tab (the FDC analog of the F1E Browsers tab, listing Microsoft Office products and supported versions), and Critical Notes.
- Fixed: the agent switch is always shown, so on a fresh/empty catalogue you can now select the DSPM + FDC agent and add rows (previously the empty state hid it).
- The wizard's DSPM + FDC compatibility panel and the report section now analyse OS support and Office Versions support separately, with matching results.
- Legacy FDC data saved under the old per-OS Office-flag model is migrated automatically (old OS rows move into the Windows tab).

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
